nc.description: Two grey, angled shafts are connected by a white, cylindrical joint featuring an internal toothed ring.
A monochromatic 3D rendering shows a mechanical assembly featuring a multi-rod component on the left connected through a central linkage block to a shaft holding three spoked wheels on the right.
Intersecting gray structural beams are secured to white rectangular base plates by white circular knobs.
A grey cylindrical rod connects to a joint assembly featuring a ridged knob positioned above a glowing white, rounded component.
A collection of light gray geometric shapes is arranged in a symmetrical, radial pattern around a central sculpted block on a white surface.

vc.description: A close-up shows a light grey mechanical assembly featuring a central shaft, a threaded collar, and an extending lever handle within an outer housing.
A mechanical assembly is depicted featuring a threaded shaft supported by a base, two C-clamps securing its central portion, and a gear mechanism with adjacent split rings on one end.
A light gray mechanical device with a central threaded rod and multiple knurled knobs is shown stationary against a white background.
A light grey mechanical device features a pistol grip, an attached braided cable, and a threaded cylindrical section containing a clear, faceted object.
A grey plastic component is centered among symmetrically arranged rolled plans, plastic pellets, and molded sprues on a white surface.
